# upstreamyard/aegra

> Multi-arch (amd64, arm64), cosign-signed container image for Aegra, the open-source self-hosted alternative to LangGraph Platform. Community-maintained by upstreamyard; not an official Aegra image. Pull `upstreamyard/aegra:<version>` or `ghcr.io/upstreamyard/aegra:<version>`. Listens on port 2026 and needs PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension, e.g. `pgvector/pgvector:pg18` (`DATABASE_URL`). Redis is needed only for multiple replicas.

Key facts: liveness `GET /live`, readiness `GET /ready`, component health `GET /health`, OpenAPI at `/openapi.json`, non-root UID 10001, migrations via `aegra db upgrade`. The bundled example agents have no authentication; auth is enabled by an `"auth"` entry in your own `aegra.json` (`AUTH_TYPE` has no effect in 0.10.8). Own agents must live under `/app` (e.g. `AEGRA_CONFIG=/app/agents/aegra.json`).

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/upstreamyard/aegra/main/README.md): quick start, configuration, Kubernetes notes, image verification
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/upstreamyard/aegra/main/AGENTS.md): image facts table, deployment rules, repository conventions

## Examples

- [docker-compose.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/upstreamyard/aegra/main/docker-compose.yml): Aegra and PostgreSQL in a single Compose file
- [Helm chart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/upstreamyard/helm-charts/main/charts/aegra/README.md): recommended for Kubernetes; `helm repo add upstreamyard https://upstreamyard.github.io/helm-charts`
- [Kubernetes manifests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/upstreamyard/aegra/main/examples/kubernetes/aegra.yaml): plain manifests without Helm: Secret, migration Job, Deployment with probes, Service
